headline: Udinese have lost 5 in a row; unbeaten Milan are next
summary: Udinese have lost 5 Serie A games in a row, conceding 13 goals across that run, and now host AC Milan. According to Yahoo Sports, Ruben Amorim is unbeaten in 7 Serie A games as Milan coach; his side are 4th with 15 points and no defeats. The market makes Milan 58.9% favourites, and its handicap line — a head start in goals — has moved from 0.74 to 0.87 in Milan's favour. With Udinese leaking chances, over 2.5 goals is 51.4%. The warning: Udinese won the last meeting 3-0 at San Siro in April.
read: Milan go to Udine unbeaten in Serie A under Ruben Amorim, rated about nine-tenths of a goal the better side and 58.9% to win. Udinese have lost five straight and concede 2.42 expected goals a game, though they did win 3-0 at San Siro in April.

facts.fact: AC Milan are 58.9% to win at Udinese — more likely than not.
facts.meaning: Milan are clear favourites for the trip to Udine, with the draw and the home side well behind.

facts.fact: Udinese have lost five Serie A games in a row, the latest 0-3 at home to Lecce on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They have scored five and conceded 13 across that run, and now host the league's only unbeaten side.

facts.fact: Ruben Amorim is unbeaten in his first seven Serie A games as AC Milan coach.
facts.meaning: Milan arrive with the new coach's unbeaten league start still intact.

facts.fact: Milan are 4th in Serie A with 15 points from 7 games, without a defeat.
facts.meaning: They arrive as a top-four side, twelve places above Udinese in the table.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line has moved from 0.74 to 0.87 goals in Milan's favour in recent days.
facts.meaning: The market now rates Milan about nine-tenths of a goal the better side, with the main line at +0.75.

facts.fact: Over 2.5 goals is priced at 51.4% for this match.
facts.meaning: The market leans slightly towards three goals or more, with the goals fair line at 2.56.

facts.fact: Udinese have conceded 2.42 expected goals per game over their last five matches.
facts.meaning: The chances they give up are high quality, and Milan are the wrong opponent to leak them against.

facts.fact: Udinese won the most recent meeting 3-0 at San Siro in April, though Milan had won the previous four.
facts.meaning: Udinese have a very recent result against this opponent to point to, even away from home.

sources.fact: AC Milan issued an official statement backing their fans' boycott of the away match at Udinese over €65 away tickets.
Milan fans are boycotting Sunday night's match at Udinese over the away ticket prices, and Milan said they will retaliate against clubs charging excessive fees.
Ruben Amorim is unbeaten in his first seven Serie A games as AC Milan coach.
David Alaba is reportedly set to miss the match against AC Milan through injury after his first Serie A appearance for Udinese.
Nicolò Zaniolo has been cleared to return to Udinese training after a muscle injury ahead of the AC Milan match.
Ruben Amorim is AC Milan's head coach, shown on the touchline during their Serie A match against Atalanta.
